name: rotli
nameCasing: lowercase always — never "Rotli" or "ROTLI" in UI/copy
status: SHIPPED — marks approved (gate round 3, 2026-06-11), board frozen, kit.json written. This is the live, app-embedded kit (src/brand/, v0.24.4).
source: Seth-approved brand board 2026-06-06, regenerated 2026-06-10 (../../engine/BRANDS/rotli/_reference/brand-board.png; intake run ../../engine/RUNS/rotli/2026-06-10-board-intake/)

identity.what: A warm, local-first, hotkey-driven notes app for Mac — one menu-bar shell where your notes folder *is* a memex (one folder: notes · chats · knowledge · files). Two fronts: Chat (AI chats) · Notes (Capture · the AI-organized 'brain' wiki areas · Storage · Boards); an email Inbox front is on the roadmap. AI rides your own CLI subscriptions (claude/codex/agy) or a local MLX model — rotli bundles no LLM/STT/TTS and has no separate Voice front (dictation lives in a sibling app, voz).
identity.essence: Warm, quiet, instant — a visitor on your screen, not a resident.
identity.oneIdea: Cognitive quiet — it holds what matters and gets out of your way.
identity.metaphor: The quokka on Rottnest Island — small, focused, always smiling because the island was designed for it. The app is the island; every module is part of it; nothing has to be learned.
taglines: I will quietly hold what matters, and I will not get in your way.

values.line: Calm beats busy. Empty surfaces beat noise.
Lamplit, never clinical. Paper under a desk lamp.
Anticipates you. No loading states for what you're already doing.
Local-first. Rebindable. The user owns the app.

identity.nameRegister: "rotli" is lowercase everywhere in copy/UI. The rounded lowercase wordmark IS the identity. Prefer rephrasing over sentence-start capitalization.
voiceRules: Calm and unhurried — the app makes no demands; the copy doesn't either.
Plainspoken and warm — friendly, never salesy, never gamified (no streaks/achievements/upsell).
Personal-first — speaks to one person managing their own scattered digital life, not a team.
Quiet confidence — the product is the proof; don't lead with AI or hype features.

type: Personal-first productivity app · Mac menu-bar · local-first · warm/calm

color.tierDiscipline: Brand core = cocoa (ink) + clay (accent). Supporting = olive (success/secondary) + peach (tint) + linen (ground). Clay is punctuation, never a field; never body text; never two clay elements competing. No pure white in light mode; cocoa is the ink (no pure black UI).

font.displayNote: Bold (700) for headings + wordmark; geometric-humanist, warm, rounded.
font.bodyNote: Regular (400) / Medium (500) for UI + body; legible at small sizes.
font.license: Fontshare (Indian Type Foundry) Free Font License — free for personal AND commercial use. Self-host. NOT OFL and NOT in the studio's standard Fontsource catalog (Mona Sans/Figtree/Inter) — a deliberate, Seth-approved deviation for rotli; recorded in LICENSES.md.
font.rejected: Cabin 600 — the prior rotli direction; retired.
font.wordmarkOutlined: logo/wordmark.svg (to be formalized — ships as outlined paths, no runtime font dependency)

mark.kind: lowercase rounded wordmark + secondary single-glyph mark
mark.primary: the full word "rotli" set lowercase in a warm rounded sans, Cocoa #3A3028; the leading "r" carries a distinctive curled/looped tail — the signature glyph.
mark.secondary: the "r" mark alone (same curled-tail r) for compact use: app icon, menu bar/tray, favicon, social avatar. Must stand alone and survive 16px mono + knockout.

meaning.warmth: Rounded terminals + the hand-drawn curl read as friendly, calm, made-for-you — paper under a lamp, not a monitor.
meaning.signature: The curled r is the one distinctive move; the wordmark and the r mark visibly share it.

mark.construction: FORMALIZED 2026-06-11 (RULES/07): quokka-r traced from the 06-10 board (smooth re-trace + flowed-bottom refinement); wordmark = outlined Baloo 2 true-600 static (fonts/Baloo2-600.ttf), tracking -0.01, with the traced r grafted as the leading glyph. Build scripts: engine/RUNS/rotli/2026-06-10-board-intake/.
mark.files: logo/ (wordmark + r-mark, each in cocoa/.mono/.mono-white) · tiles/ (favicon, app-icon-512, social-avatar-1024, tile-linen/cocoa/clay)

shape.note: Rounded + soft throughout — nothing sharp or clinical. The wordmark's roundness sets the tone.

candidates: soft paper-grain / dot texture at very low opacity
the curled-r flourish as a sparing motif
texture.note: Provisional — explore at the pattern step. Quiet, not busy; opacities below conscious perception. Construct programmatically.

icons.system: outline · consistent stroke · 24-grid · one idea each · hover label on every icon (quokka principle) · accent sparingly with clay (olive for success/sync)

motion.principle: calm + instant — the app visits, it doesn't sweep in
signatures: window show/hide = crossfade with a 1px lift (not a slide)

logo.primary: logo/wordmark.svg — the wordmark IS the primary logo (per the board; no separate lockup)
logo.icon: logo/r-mark.svg (+ .mono / .mono-white) — the secondary logo, compact use
logo.clearspace: ≥ the x-height of the wordmark on all sides
logo.minIcon: the r mark survives 16px mono (favicon floor) + knockout — verified 2026-06-11

supersedes.priorIdentity: The earlier rotli direction (copper #B87A4E accent, Cabin 600, quokka-face tray icon) is RETIRED. The quokka remains the brand metaphor/voice, not necessarily the literal logo (the curled r is the mark now).
